People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Agenda

Committee: People's Majlis Environment and Climate Change Committee
Meeting: 4th meeting
Venue: Committee Room 6
Date: 15 June 2026 (Monday)
Time: 11:00

1. Discussion on the work of the Committee.
- Matter submitted sharing concerns about the services of Fenaka Corporation in Fuvahmulah.
- Letter sent regarding sharing the work being carried out in association with the International Organization of Supreme Audit Institutions.
- Letter sent by Project Thimaaveshi and several other associations sharing concerns about the damage that would result from reducing the protected area of Eedhigali Kilhi and Koattey for a project planned to widen the Link Road in Hithadhoo, Addu City.
- Letter expressing concerns about running a housing project in the Funavau area of Villimalé, sent together with the views of various parties on the matter.
- Letter sent sharing concerns about land reclamation work in the Moolekede Fishimathi [unclear] area of Addu.
